Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.
Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.
With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in Deloitte’s Fast 500 (four years running!), LinkedIn’s Top Startups , Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!), Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !

Attentive's customers use our platform to run digital and in-store marketing programs that are critical to the revenue of their brands, and they notice immediately when something is wrong. Support is where the product meets the customer under pressure. We are hiring a Director of Support to own how that experience is delivered: the leadership team, the operating model, the budget, and the service commitments we make to customers.
You’ll inherit a functioning support organization with a strong foundation: three support tiers, clearly defined standards, and established SLOs. We’re looking for a Support Operations leader with deep expertise in tooling and automation. AI is already deployed across deflection, agent assist, and quality management, while offshore partners support a growing share of operations.
The next chapter requires a leader who can define Support’s commitments, integrate its people and technology, and set the direction for the organization’s continued evolution.
Concretely, you’ll lead the Support management team across the US, UK, and Australia; define the operating model and quality bar; own the budget and capacity plan; design a premium support offering from the ground up; and serve as the decision-maker for the company and our customers when Support needs to make a call.
This is a strategic operator role. You won’t be building automations or working the queue, you’ll determine what Support is accountable for, what it should cost, and how it can scale without headcount growing in proportion to volume.
What You’ll Accomplish
Lead the management team. Manage Support Managers and the Team Lead structure across US, UK, and Australia. Hire, develop, and hold a high standard for the people who lead the team day to day.
Own the operating model. Set the target state for tier design (L1/L2/L3), what stays stateside versus offshore, regional coverage, and peak-period operations. Sequence the transition and hold the team to it.
Manage offshore and partner capacity. Decide what work is delivered by partner teams versus stateside, how the teams work together, and how quality and SLO parity are maintained across both. Run the partner performance cadence, with Revenue Strategy & Operations supporting contracting and vendor management.
Manage budget and capacity. Own the headcount model, BPO spend, and tooling spend. Build a cost and capacity model that ties staffing to volume and SLO attainment and is used for annual planning.
Set the quality bar. Own the KPI and SLO framework, the QA program, and performance standards by tier. Accountable for CSAT, SLO attainment, and resolution trends.
Own customer-facing commitments. Design and launch a premium/enterprise support offering with tier-based SLAs Support can consistently meet. Set scope boundaries with CS, Services, and Sales, and provide the paid or self-serve alternative when work falls outside scope.
Establish Support Engineering as a discipline. Define the leadership model, technical bar, career path, and relationship with Engineering for our Level 3 team.
Be the senior escalation point. For customers, CS leadership, and the executive team. Own the CS incident-management program at the program level.
Partner across the company. Product and Engineering on supportability and customer-driven roadmap input; CS and Services on scope and handoffs; Enablement and Product Marketing on self-serve and launch readiness.
Your Expertise
Experience leading a B2B SaaS support or CX organization through a meaningful change in how work is delivered—such as a tier redesign or transition to partner or offshore teams. You have been accountable for both the outcome and execution.
Several years of experience managing managers and developing strong leaders.
Experience managing a support budget and building capacity models that inform staffing decisions.
A track record of holding clear scope boundaries with internal stakeholders while offering workable alternatives.
Experience running support for a data- or integration-heavy product, where data discrepancies and integration failures are common issues. You don’t need to debug them, but you should be credible with the people who do.
Experience deploying AI in a support context, with a clear understanding of deflection quality, failure modes, and where humans need to remain in the loop. You will be accountable for the results; someone else will build the tools.
Experience working alongside a strong, technical operations leader and giving them the space to do their best work.

Martech, ecommerce, or analytics background.

Eingebettet in den Helvetia-Konzern bündelt unser 30-köpfiges Team die physische und digitale Kundenberatung der Baloise Bank. Wir stellen sicher, dass unsere Kundschaft an den Standorten Solothurn, Olten, Grenchen und Dornach sowie über sämtliche Direktkanäle wie E-Mail oder Messenger erstklassig betreut wird. * Du bringst dich proaktiv ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren.
## Was du mitbringst ##

About Astra
Astra is building mission-critical infrastructure for moving money at scale. Our platform processes billions in annual transaction volume with 99.9%+ uptime, powering real-time transfers, bank debits, card disbursements, and complex financial compliance systems. We provide APIs and automation tools that enable businesses to move money programmatically while maintaining strict regulatory requirements.

We're looking for an API Support Specialist to join our Integrations team as we scale our payments API platform. You will be a front-line problem solver for our customers and their end-users.

This person will manage inbound support tickets — including tickets submitted by clients on behalf of their own end-users — troubleshoot integration and payment issues, and provide clear, timely resolutions.

The role requires strong problem-solving instincts, comfort with technical systems, and the ability to translate complex issues into clear solutions for customers.
You'll be the accessible, always-on technical resource for any client on our platform, regardless of account size — the person who makes sure issues get resolved fast and consistently, and who knows exactly when something needs to go to a specialist instead.

Own and resolve inbound technical support tickets across our full client base — API errors, integration questions, configuration issues, transaction discrepancies, and similar day-to-day technical problems
Meet defined response and resolution SLAs, prioritizing by severity and client impact
Triage incoming issues and make clear escalation calls — routing account-specific complexity to the appropriate Technical Account Manager, and any suspected platform-wide or systemic issues to engineering
Maintain and grow our internal knowledge base and runbooks, documenting resolutions so recurring issues get solved faster (or become self-serve) over time
Monitor ticket trends to spot patterns — flagging when the same issue is showing up across multiple unrelated clients, which often signals a systemic problem worth raising upstream
Communicate clearly and professionally with clients' technical teams, translating technical detail into plain, actionable guidance
Contribute feedback on recurring pain points to help inform product and documentation improvements
Help build the support function itself: as an early team member, you'll shape our macros, escalation paths, SLAs, and internal playbooks rather than just follow existing ones.

1-3 years' experience in a technical support, API support, or technical customer-facing role, ideally in fintech, payments, or another API-first product
Comfort reading API documentation, logs, and error responses, and troubleshooting integration issues methodically
Familiarity with REST APIs, webhooks, and common authentication patterns (API keys, OAuth)
Strong written communication — able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to prioritize under pressure across multiple open tickets with different urgency levels
A structured, checklist-minded approach to troubleshooting, paired with good judgment about when a problem is outside your depth and needs to be escalated
Comfortable working with basic scripting/tooling to investigate issues (SQL queries, API testing tools like Postman, log searching) — not required to write production code

Prior experience at a payments, fintech, or developer-tools company
Experience with support ticketing platforms (Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar) and internal monitoring/observability tools
Exposure to basic scripting (Python, JavaScript) for investigating issues
How success is measured
SLA adherence: first response time and time-to-resolution across ticket severity tiers
Ticket resolution rate without escalation, balanced against escalation quality (routing the right issues to the right specialist)
Client satisfaction on resolved tickets
Contribution to knowledge base growth and reduction in repeat/known issues over time
Why this role matters
This role is a critical building block for our Integrations team as we scale. It ensures every client — not just our largest accounts — gets fast, reliable technical support, and it protects our more specialized Technical Account Managers' ability to focus on the proactive, account-specific work that keeps our most important relationships healthy and growing.
